item.text:
{"brief":"The user says they like documentaries, but gave no examples or explanation of that preference. They really enjoyed The Godfather, calling it a good piece of cinematic work and praising its creativity and inventiveness.

They strongly disliked an Ali G movie whose title they could not remember and stopped watching after roughly 5–10 minutes; their account varied on the exact duration. They found it awful despite loving the TV show and expecting the film to be better. This supports a dislike of that particular film, not a general rejection of comedy.

They have not seen an unidentified Amy Schumer movie they described as featuring her with an alcohol bottle. They only reported hearing that it was bad, so this is not a firsthand judgment.

They have not seen The Matrix, although they have heard much about it and recognize references to the pills. They also have not seen Wonder Woman; they reported hearing that the Wonder Woman TV show was good, without expressing a personal assessment. The assistant introduced these titles as questions, and the user did not commit to watching any of them."}
